obfuscation_indicators: considerable judgment and subject to change
risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantitative disclosure, but results show severe deterioration in sales, margins, operating income, net income, and cash generation. Management presents an optimistic 2025 recovery outlook while relying on broad assumptions regarding demand, market recovery, customer behavior, and future growth. Extensive standard forward-looking disclaimers and judgment-based accounting language limit the specificity of downside analysis.
